jp: 今、麟君の、って\n言ったよね
en: Just now, she said "Rin-kun's," didn't she?

jp: 麟の物が落ちてた\nっぽい？
en: Looks like something of Rin's got dropped?

jp: ああ、何か\n麟の持ち物を\n拾ったみたいだ
en: Yes. It seems she picked up something belonging to Rin.
An important item left at the scene, then.

jp: 事件の手がかり、\nってわけね
en: So it's a clue to the case, huh.

jp: うん、\n早速刻音を作ろう
en: Yes. Let's make an Echo right away.

jp: 【佳子の拾い物】\nの刻音を手に入れた！
